surviving_claim.plain_language: On a frozen authored holdout, retaining polarity and an explicit non-merge outcome prevented six false agreements made by the registered flat rule without increasing false splits relative to the conservative control; a separate authored eight-state battery confirmed deterministic interface conformance.
surviving_claim.posterior_change: The fixed panels increase confidence that the coordinate condition prevents the observed polarity-collapse errors in this authored setting, but they do not support population or deployed-system superiority.

hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The evidence mass and external validity are insufficient for a full-length general semantic-integration paper.
hostile_panel.closure_test: Use a short Brief Report, make the fixed-panel observation the only headline result, and remove all population, deployed-system and broad external-validity language.

hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The 32 holdout cases collapse to three authored families, only one family discriminates the rules, and the 400 conformance records collapse to eight candidate-visible states.
hostile_panel.closure_test: Report three families and eight states as the scientific units, label bootstrap intervals descriptive fixed-panel diagnostics, preserve all nulls, and disclose the comparator-interface mismatch.

hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The panels do not establish the independent necessity of every coordinate or a general theorem about scientific integration.
hostile_panel.closure_test: Define the evaluated projection and decision rule exactly while limiting interpretation to the observed polarity and non-merge mechanism.

hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The independent scorer shares repository snapshot and custody, and no deployed integration system or independently governed naturalistic corpus was evaluated.
hostile_panel.closure_test: Treat deterministic rebuilds and the independent scorer as integrity and implementation checks only; broader authority would require source-disjoint external custody and matched deployed comparators.

hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The contribution could be mistaken for a replacement for ontology matching, ontological unpacking, FAIR variable modelling or scientific information extraction.
hostile_panel.closure_test: Name the nearest works and state that the contribution is only a downstream claim-relative merge decision after structured projections already exist.

scientific_mass.independent_unit_type: Confirmatory authored case families for the holdout, with the conformance mechanism counted separately as unique candidate-visible states
scientific_mass.dependence_notes: The holdout has 32 cases in three authored families and only the polarity-related family discriminates the rules. The separate conformance battery has 400 generated records but only eight unique candidate-visible states, each repeated 50 times. The two masses are not pooled.
scientific_mass.failure_opportunities: Six polarity-contrast cases exposed the flat rule's false merges. Nineteen cases in the other two families did not discriminate the rules. The conformance battery exercised eight declared decision archetypes.
adverse_or_null_results: The other two holdout families, comprising 19 cases, did not discriminate the rules.
Four coordinate-ablation cells produced zero measured change and are interpreted as absent comparison opportunity rather than dispensability.
The false-split difference from the conservative rule was zero.
The information-equivalent typed implementation tied the complete rule at 400/400.
The structured-semantic comparator has a narrower terminal interface, so its 250/400 score is not a general capability comparison.

nearest_external_works: Bernasconi, Guizzardi, Pastor and Storey (2022), Semantic interoperability: ontological unpacking of a viral conceptual model
Santos, Faria, Pesquita and Couto (2015), Ontology alignment repair through modularization and confidence-based heuristics
Magagna et al. (2021), The I-ADOPT interoperability framework for FAIRer data descriptions of biodiversity
Vogt et al. (2025), Suggestions for extending the FAIR principles based on a linguistic perspective on semantic interoperability
novelty.component_novelty: Explicitly retaining referent, construct, measurement, context, polarity, modality and attribution is not claimed as individually novel.
novelty.composition_novelty: The contribution is the evaluated claim-relative merge decision with a typed non-merge and undetermined outcome on the frozen authored panels.
novelty.emergent_result: The bounded emergent observation is that preserving polarity and the non-merge terminal removes the six observed flat-rule false agreements without a measured false-split increase.
novelty.theory_lineage: The work is positioned downstream of ontology matching, ontological unpacking, I-ADOPT, FAIR semantic interoperability, provenance-bearing statements and scientific information extraction.

comparisons.minimum_mechanism: Preserve polarity and permit an explicit non-merge decision on already-structured projections.
baseline_roles: Flat predicate canonicalization is the deliberately weak false-merge mechanism ablation.
Exact-coordinate conservative matching is the false-split control.
The structured-semantic product is an interface-attainability comparator with a narrower terminal alphabet.
The information-equivalent typed implementation is an exact identity control.

external_validity.description: Identifier-disjoint authored holdout cases assembled from pinned public resources and deterministic standards, with limited source overlap, same-programme gold decisions and no independently governed naturalistic deployment.

integrity_evidence: Prospectively frozen case digest, source revisions, evaluator identities, seed, margins and terminal rule
Deterministic source-archive rebuilds reproduce both PDFs byte for byte
A standard-library scorer independently reimplements the holdout decision logic within the same repository snapshot
scientific_validity_evidence: Prospectively frozen 32-case holdout with explicit family accounting
Paired fixed-panel false-merge and false-split diagnostics
Ablations, non-discriminating cases and exact-identity control retained in the report

sibling_overlap.merge_test: Retain ORION-13 only as the narrow fixed-panel coordinate-governed mapping note; any broader epistemic-state, recursive-reconstruction or research-system claim belongs to the named sibling programmes.

next_discriminator.task: Run independently governed, source-disjoint naturalistic cases with strong same-universe comparators at matched information if a broader paper is pursued.
next_discriminator.why_it_changes_decision: That evidence could reduce designer advantage, test transport beyond authored panels and determine whether the mechanism is competitive rather than merely conformant.
next_discriminator.closure_test: A frozen external protocol yields adjudicated source-disjoint cases, matched comparator inputs and independently held outcomes, with all null and adverse results released.

decision.reason: The fixed authored panels support a short methods observation but not a full-length general paper; F1000Research Brief Report is the resolved route without adding new science.
